name: mouse1m
what: 10x E18 mouse brain, 1.3 M cells, with a marker-guided trajectory. Main fixture: most pages run here. Needs the current (v2, H5) format.

name: ren
what: Ren et al. COVID-19 immune atlas, 1.46 M cells, TCR and BCR. Only for the pages the mouse brain does not have: Immune repertoire, Extra material.

name: cosmx
what: NanoString CosMx NSCLC, 800 k+ cells, 8 samples. Only for Spatial. Not built yet: set PERF_COSMX_CRB.

name: tcell
what: Pan-cancer T cell atlas (Zheng 2021), 398 k cells. No page is assigned to it: the mouse brain already has the Trajectory and Ren the Immune repertoire. Registered for later use.
